name: diffier
description: IntelliJ-style Git diff editor for macOS
author: Alan Fitzgerald

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.highlighter.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && yarn build:preload
scripts.test: yarn build && node test/git.test.js && node test/keymap.test.js && node test/themes.test.js && node test/languages.test.js
scripts.postinstall: yarn build:highlighter || node -e "console.warn('shiki highlighter bundle skipped; falling back to built-in grammars')"; yarn build:mermaid || node -e "console.warn('mermaid bundle skipped; mermaid fences will render as plain code blocks')"
scripts.dist: yarn build && yarn build:highlighter && yarn build:mermaid && BUILD_NUMBER=${BUILD_NUMBER:-dev} electron-builder --mac
